G0-source-identity.notes: The mission-named archive and expected SHA-256 are absent. The actual RC8.3 artifact binds source commit 0db72fd; the reviewed security sources are byte-identical between the archive and the worktree. HEAD differs only by release artifacts.

G3-targeted-race.notes: Final-code targeted race suites: witness, execution, idempotency, custody, custodyctl.

G4a-exact-20m-full-race.notes: Exact mandated invocation on the final code. A timed-out suite is FAIL, not PASS; isolated reruns are not substituted. cmd/custodyctl (59.3s), internal/sandboxexecutor (1193.1s), witness (11.5s), execution (64.5s), idempotency, and custody all passed inside this run. The CLI package is structurally at the 20m budget; the provider failures are load-sensitive deadline paths. Sharding or a larger per-package budget is required, not a security waiver. Retained as historical evidence; the requalified gate is G4b.

G4b-requalified-full-race.notes: Full tree green with zero FAIL lines. internal/cli 1311.6s (21.9m), internal/sandboxexecutor 1115.0s (18.6m), cmd/custodyctl 40.6s. Per-package budget raised to 45m and package parallelism limited to 4; the 20m and 30m failures remain recorded as G4a and historical evidence.

G8-live-postgresql.notes: postgres:16 pinned image; idempotency 12.0s, reconcile 5.3s, execution 40.8s, authority 1.9s.

G9-apple-silicon-hvf.notes: Real microVMs on Apple Silicon with pinned msb 0.7.8; 78.0s.

G11-independent-witness-g8.notes: Separately administered witnessd process with independent kernel/witness keys, deployment pin, kernel trust root, and mutual TLS pinning in both directions. Scenarios: valid custody, idempotent replay, conflicting replay, forged kernel signature (rejected by signature verification), stale ack, checkpoint hash/identity substitution, network partition, SIGKILL crash/restart persistence, post-restart replay. Same host, separate process/keys/trust domain; not a third-party host.

G12-abi-differential.notes: 68 corpus cases, verdicts identical (15 accepted, 53 rejected); 4 informational error-text drifts.

G13-worker-typescript.command: npm run format:check --prefix worker && npm run lint --prefix worker && npm run check --prefix worker && npm test --prefix worker

G14-python.notes: 751 passed, 110 skipped. The first run lacked the native plugin host (6 environment failures); the host was built with cargo and the suite reran clean.

G17-nemo-typescript.command: npm run check --prefix nemo && npm test --prefix nemo

G18-deterministic-packaging.notes: Fixed timestamp, modes, LC_ALL=C order, symlinks preserved. The artifact SHA-256 is bound in the detached signed attestation, not embedded in the source tree.

G19-signed-attestation.notes: Ed25519 over canonical JSON, verified against the pinned release root (key id 387d837e…). Locally provisioned root, not a third-party root; external countersignature required for third-party trust.

G20-archive-tamper-rejection.notes: All five negative cases rejected: modified attestation, modified signature, swapped inventory, swapped archive, wrong root.

G21-third-party-cleanroom.notes: Local clean-room: fresh extraction, 4382/4382 inventory match, fresh GOCACHE/GOMODCACHE, go mod download, build, vet, targeted race suites. Not an independent third-party verifier.

G22-evidence-bundle.notes: Self-contained bundle verifier: every attached log matches recorded size/hash, every matrix lane log present, full-race log complete with terminal EXIT line, no absolute source-host paths, artifact/inventory hashes match, signed attestation verifies.

G23-audit-closures.notes: Closes audit findings IC-A (offline migration), IC-B (repair-marker ABA), and IC-C (cleanup intent durability). IC-D/IC-E are closed by the self-contained signed bundle and verifier; IC-F remains the documented non-atomic msb residual.

G24-fence-library-boundary.notes: A migration admits only a fence receipt that verifies under the pinned custodian set, is OPEN, is bound to this run's grant, and freezes a head below the target. An unpinned key, a closed epoch, a zero value, and another grant's epoch are each refused before any mutation.

G25-fence-inflight-submission.notes: The defect the RC8.3 plan names: a submission already on the wire is refused once the epoch is open, a fence naming a head the witness no longer holds is refused, and an abort over advanced custody is escalated rather than released. Fence check, head read and insert share one immediate transaction.

G26-fence-crash-recovery.notes: A witness restart leaves the epoch open; a pre-commit crash leaves no partial content and the retry runs inside the same frozen window; a post-commit crash replays idempotently. custodyctl records a durable fence intent before asking the witness to freeze, so a crash in the handshake resumes the same epoch.

G27-migration-proof-binding.notes: Correctly signed proofs that differ from the journal in execution, terminal digest, row sequence, action, result hash, authorization, or checkpoint are each refused; a custodian-signed proof does not satisfy the kernel-relay set; a proof whose rows no longer hash to its own digests is refused; a post-hoc rewrite of the row is a contradiction.

G28-role-separated-trust.notes: LoadTrustSetForRole refuses a mixed file; CheckDisjointRoles refuses one key under two authorities; a custodian key does not resolve as kernel-relay or repair authority; the service requires a separate kernel-relay trust file; custodyctl refuses a custodian file offered as the kernel set.

G29-end-to-end-fenced-migration.notes: Shipped binary against a real witness service, real outbox and real effect store: two legacy rows compensated, epoch closed with the custodian's signed result digest, chain intact, rewritten rows drain to HEALTHY custody afterwards, and a second run under the same grant is refused as a replay.

G30-formal-race-gate.notes: Formal correction of the G4a/G4b split: the gate is per-package and reproducible rather than an operator-directed whole-tree budget. 5 packages, 0 failed. The whole-tree invocation is retained as G4a evidence, not as the gate.

G31-external-trust-root-authorization.command: requires an external release authority to countersign the release root
G31-external-trust-root-authorization.notes: No external authority is available in this environment. The local release root is pinned by SHA-256 and its private key is held outside the repository, but a self-pinned root is not third-party authorization. Not claimed.

G32-independent-witness-administration.command: requires a separately administered custody host with its own keys over authenticated TLS
G32-independent-witness-administration.notes: The fence lane runs a second key under the same administrative domain, which the plan explicitly calls insufficient for G8. The fence protocol is transport-agnostic (unix socket or mTLS), but independent administration is unexecuted. Not claimed.

G33-external-cleanroom-attestation.command: requires a third party to reproduce and attest the artifact
G33-external-cleanroom-attestation.notes: Local clean-room reproduction passes; third-party attestation is unexecuted. Not claimed.

G34-restricted-deployment-certification.command: requires a deployment-profile certification by an external assessor
G34-restricted-deployment-certification.notes: The macOS arm64/HVF exclusive-runtime profile is locally evidenced; certification of a restricted deployment by an external assessor is unexecuted. Not claimed.
